BIG APPLEROUTE
A DAWN PAPER ROUTE IN BROOKLYN

HOW TO PLAY

🚲 Ride the Brooklyn block at dawn. AD/←→ steer · W boost · S brake · Space hop (tap again in air for a trick) · hold Shift manual.

📰 Throw: tap Q/E to snap-throw, or hold to charge — release as the fill meets a tick for a PERFECT long-range curve or balcony lob. Hold C to bank off the far wall. Subscribers live on the far (upper-left) side, so both throw keys aim there — in boss fights Q/E aim left/right. Trees block flat shots! A green ✓ means delivered, a red ✕ means a window.

✅ Hit mailboxes, stoops, balconies of subscribers · 💥 smash windows of non-subscribers (angry neighbours chase you) · ☕ happy fans toss coffee boosts.

🛹 Grind rails, hop cab roofs, launch off ramps, ride walls · mid-air throws score double. Take branch lanes (alley, subway, bridge, boardwalk, rooftop) for bigger multipliers.

🌧 Watch for rain, parades, marathons, film shoots, power cuts, garbage strikes · a rival scooter steals subscribers · Sunday = boss. Earn tips, buy bikes, outfits and papers in the Garage.

⚔ Versus (2P): P1 ADW QE Space · P2 ←→↑ KL Enter. Touch: each half of the screen — drag to steer, tap to hop, flick to throw.

📱 Touch: drag left half to steer · hold the THROW buttons to charge · HOP, MANUAL, BOOST, BANK buttons.
